description:
Problem: the policy allows only the omp harness (policy.HARNESSES is ("omp",), and policy loading rejects any other harness at policy.py:148), yet verdict.parse_output still unwraps Claude result envelopes (structured_output, result, and the stream fallback in _stream_result) and agy status/response envelopes. Every production caller passes omp: runner.py passes reviewer.harness, which the policy restricts to omp, and candidate_checks.py passes "omp". Three tests still pin the dead Claude path: test_report_body_cap.py parametrizes the harness over "claude" in two tests, and test_response_ingress.py parses a Claude envelope.

Outcome: parse_output handles only OMP's event stream and its internal text step. Delete the Claude and agy branches and _stream_result. Keep _strip_fence while the text step still accepts fenced JSON. Move the huge-integer and duplicate-key tests onto the omp and text paths so their invariants stay covered, and drop the Claude-envelope test.
